app.name: Koch-Chemie Car Tracker
app.signInLead: Sign in to log vehicle prep jobs.

auth.error: Couldn't sign in — check your email and password.
auth.forgotHelp: Forgotten your password? Ask your manager or an admin to send you a new invitation — there is no self-service reset.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
welcome.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
welcome.invalidLink: This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask your admin to send a new one.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.signOutConfirm: Sign out? You'll need your email and password to get back in.

team.title: Team
team.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They will be signed out and cannot submit jobs until reactivated.
team.activateConfirm: Reactivate {{name}}? They will be able to sign in and submit jobs again.
team.cannotChange: Only workers at your site can be changed here
team.emptyBody: Workers appear here once an admin has invited them to your site.

services.title: Services
services.missingFields: Catalog number and name are required.
services.duplicateCatalog: That catalog number is already in use.
services.deleteConfirm: Remove this service? Past jobs keep it.
services.deactivateConfirm: Hide this service from workers? Past jobs keep it, and you can turn it back on.
services.orderHint: Workers see the services in this order — put the most common ones first.
services.workerPriceHint: what the worker is paid per job
services.priceInvalid: Worker price must be a number, zero or more.
services.emptyBody: Add the work your sites perform. Workers pick from this list on every job.

queue.title: Waiting to sync
queue.body: Saved on this phone. They submit automatically as soon as you have a connection — you don't need to do anything.

newJob.title: New Job
newJob.photoTooLarge: That photo is too large (max 8MB) — please retake it
newJob.ocrUnreadable: Couldn't read it ({{reason}}) — enter manually or retake the photo
newJob.editWindow: You can edit this for 15 minutes
newJob.plateInvalid: Doesn't look like a valid plate — check and edit if needed
newJob.vinInvalid: VIN must be 17 characters (no I, O, or Q)
newJob.vinChecksumWarning: VIN checksum doesn't match — common for imported vehicles, double check the photo
newJob.duplicateWarning: This VIN was already logged in the last 7 days
newJob.queuedOffline: No connection — saved on this phone and it will submit automatically once you're back online
newJob.fixTitle_one: {{count}} thing to finish before you can submit
newJob.fixTitle_other: {{count}} things to finish before you can submit
newJob.typeItInHint: Couldn't read it — check and type it in
newJob.extraPhotosHint: Damage, interior, anything worth a record. Up to {{count}}.

myJobs.title: My Jobs
myJobs.emptyBody: Every car you submit shows up here. You can change the services and the note for 15 minutes afterwards.
myJobs.lockedHint: The 15-minute edit window has closed — ask your manager to change it.
myJobs.editableSoon: Under a minute left to edit
myJobs.queuedHint: Not submitted yet — waiting for a connection

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.search: Search today — plate, VIN, or worker
dashboard.scopeNote: Search covers the day shown above.
dashboard.noResults: No jobs today match that search. Only today's jobs are searchable here.
dashboard.emptyBody: Jobs appear here as workers submit them, newest first.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.lead: Every job, newest first. Fill in receipt numbers here.
jobs.search: Search plate, VIN, or receipt number
jobs.saveFailed: Not saved — check your connection and try again
jobs.duplicateQuestion: This looks like a repeat of {{plate}}, logged {{date}} by {{worker}} ({{service}}). Delete this copy? It leaves exports and the day's list, and a manager can restore it from the job page.
jobs.duplicateUnknown: This job is flagged as a repeat, but the earlier one can't be shown — it may have been deleted or belong to another site. Delete this copy? A manager can restore it from the job page.
jobs.emptyBody: Jobs appear here as workers submit them.
jobs.noMatchesBody: Try a wider date range, or clear the filters to see everything.

jobDetail.title: Job
jobDetail.duplicateOf: Possible duplicate of an earlier job for this VIN
jobDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete this job? It disappears from today's list and from exports. A manager can restore it from here.
jobDetail.deletedNotice: This job is deleted. It is excluded from exports until you restore it.
jobDetail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.

photo.missingBody: Either it was never uploaded, or the job is over 90 days old and the photo has been removed.
photo.deniedBody: Your session may have expired. Sign out and back in, then try again.
photo.failedBody: Check your connection — the photo itself is fine.

export.title: Export
export.periodHelp: Both reports below cover this date range. Change it to change which jobs they include.
export.periodIncomplete: Set both a start and an end date.
export.emptyWorker: {{worker}} has no jobs in this period — nothing to export.
export.empty: No jobs in that date range — nothing to export.
export.customerHelp: This file goes to the customer. It never contains worker names or worker pay.
export.noColumns: No columns are switched on, so the report would be blank. Configure it below.
export.paymentsHelp: Internal payroll sheet for one worker: their jobs in the date range, with a per-service summary and total. Do not send this to a customer.
export.configHelp: Tick the columns the customer should see and put them in the order you want them in the file. Applies to every customer report for this site.

admin.name: Name
admin.inviteSent: Invitation sent — they'll set a password from the email link.
admin.sessionNotRevoked: User updated, but their sign-in session could not be revoked — contact an administrator
admin.inviteMissingFields: Email, name, and site are required.
admin.usersEmptyBody: Invite the first person with the form above.
admin.sitesDuplicate: A site with that name already exists.
admin.sitesWarning: Site names appear on every export and analytics screen, and cannot be edited or removed here. Check the spelling before adding.
admin.sitesEmptyBody: Add the locations where vehicles are prepared.

stats.emptyBody: Your counts start from the first car you submit. Nothing is missing.
